result.title: Async-RBench: Benchmarking Asynchronous Task Execution in LLM Agents
result.comment: 25 pages, 16 figures. Code is available at https://github.com/pope8zdt/Async-RBench
result.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly execute tasks asynchronously: a main agent continues working while its subagents run, and the task state may change before their results arrive. The main agent must decide which work to update or preserve and which checks to repeat, while avoiding prohibited changes. Final task success alone does not reveal whether these results were handled correctly, and natural asynchronous arrivals are hard to reproduce. We introduce Async-RBench, a benchmark for asynchronous task execution in LLM agents, with 200 executable tasks covering eight scenarios. A scenario controller regulates result delivery using predefined task-state conditions, while an Event Response Contract (ERC) specifies what each response must change, preserve, avoid, and re-verify. The Dynamic Replanning Score (DRS) weights the response process and outcome equally and is reported separately from task success. We evaluate nine agents and find DRS scores of 19.2 to 45.1, with the lowest scores on duplicate reports and subagent failures. Under our execution protocol, all nine agents obtain lower task success with asynchronous than with batched delivery (26.0% vs. 29.7% on average). For three agents, prompting the main agent to rebuild its plan after every result improves DRS by only 2.6 to 3.5 points. Together, these findings highlight the challenges of reliable asynchronous task execution and the need to evaluate how agents handle incoming results alongside end-to-end task success.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Async-RBench：包含 200 个可执行任务与八类场景，由场景控制器按预设任务状态条件投递子代理结果，并用 Event Response Contract 规定每次响应必须改变、保留、回避与重新核验的内容；另设 Dynamic Replanning Score 将过程与结果等权计分，与任务成功率分开报告，用于评测 LLM 主代理在异步结果到达时的处理能力。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文关注「新证据异步到达后，哪些状态该更新或保留、哪些检查要重做」，这一证据纳入与状态修订问题可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、latent 推理状态更新及复核/停止决策提供评价设计线索，可供核查。
